changes: Added a native tool-capability inventory to the mandatory operational-access discovery contract so one missing connector method cannot be treated as connector-wide exhaustion.

Added executable non-interactive diagnostic fallback states and routing: NONINTERACTIVE_FALLBACK_INCOMPLETE, NONINTERACTIVE_PATH_FOUND, NONINTERACTIVE_FALLBACK_EXHAUSTED and PLATFORM_CONSENT_REQUIRED.

Required GitHub Actions diagnostics to exhaust available run metadata, jobs, step summaries, job logs, artifacts, checks/check-runs/annotations or statuses, workflow definitions, repository-return evidence and relevant historical runs before browser/tool-consent escalation.
Made repository-return diagnostics through sanitized GitHub logs, artifacts, checks or durable evidence preferable to Owner terminal copy/paste or interactive browser routing.
Aligned Project Leader, Runbook, Recovery Protocol, Supervisor, Recovery Guardian, packaged skills and automated/smoke tests while preserving canonical plugin version compatibility.

Canonicalized unique task 042 merge/hygiene transition evidence and added exact-revision Owner-authorized cleanup records for obsolete control/merge-authorization-042 and abandoned builder/noninteractive-fallback-hygiene-043 after integration.
Preserved PR #43 closed and unmerged as durable failure evidence rather than weakening or rewriting append-only recovery validation.
